problem:
| $x$ | **$-2$** | **$-1$** | **$0$** | **$1$** | **$2$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-1$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $5$ |

Find the line of the form $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x$ that best fits the data above.

*Hint: You can use the fact that*

$$
({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}=\frac{1}{10}[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,{X}^{T}y=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 14\end{aligned}],
$$

*where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector.*
